page.layout: One column of running text on the left printed page: running head at the top, text below it. The strip of the neighbouring page along the right edge is not transcribed. No margin notes, no footnotes.

main_text.p: Naturam & Ufum paulò diligentiùs inquirerem, & quæ mihi in eam rem fcitu digna meditanti occur-riffent, vobis auditoribus pro officii mei ratione, ex hoc loco communicarem. Statui igitur hac prælectione Conscientiæ Naturam definiendo explicare: expositurus futuris lectionibus (si Deus concesserit[?]) Conscientiæ, maximè quà facienda spectat, Ufum & Officia, idque per duplicem respectum; priorem sc. ad normam legis cui subesse debet, posteriorem ad actus humanos quibus nata est præesse.

II. Sed quum sit duplex methodus definitiva, altera συνθετικὴ & ad Compositionis modum, quæ præmissa singularum partium expensione, integram tandem colligit definitionem; altera ἀναλυτικὴ & per modum Resolutionis, quæ propositam ab initio integram definitionem postea membratim aperit & explicat: etsi prior illa videri forsitan[?] possit ordini naturæ convenientior, delegi tamen[?] potiùs posteriorem, quæ visa est mihi ad docendum aliquanto commodior. Sic ergo breviter definio Conscientiam: Conscientia est facultas, sive habitus intellectus practici, quo mens hominis per dis-curfum rationis applicat lumen quod sibi adest, ad particulares suos actus morales. Ubi considerandi veniunt suo ordine; Primò Definiti nomen, nimirum ipsa Conscientiæ vox: deinde singula definitionis membra; illa videlicet omnia, quæ in definiendis primæ vel secundæ speciei Qualitatibus adhiberi solent, Genus, Subjectum, Objectum, & Actus Proprius.

III. Definiti nomen quod attinet, observârunt viri docti non reperiri in Veteri Instrumento vocem Hebræam, quæ Conscientiam peculiariter & præcisè significet: sed ex usu loquendi Hebræorum, quoties de Conscientiâ sermo est, ad eam denotandam assumi fere duarum dictionum alterutram ידע[?] sive רוח[?], quarum illam proprié Cor, hanc Spiritum.

page.notes: Hebrew words are uncertain: the first glyph group (printed as "ƆƆ7") is read as ידע[?] but may be לב (cor), and the second (printed as "ΓΊΓ1") is read as רוח[?] (spiritus). Both should be checked against the scan. "forsitan" is partly hidden by a stain and read with [?]. The first "(si Deus ...)" phrase is damaged: "concesserit" is inferred from the visible letters. "delegi tamen" is at a line end and the hyphen is not clear. The right-hand strip is the edge of the neighbouring page and is left out.
